# Wyze Cameras with Existing RTSP Firmware

View or capture frames and bounded recordings from compatible Wyze Cam v2, Cam v3 or Cam Pan v1 through Muse Home Link, read-only, only when legacy RTSP firmware is already installed and enabled with TCP media transport. That legacy firmware is discontinued and unpatched, which the skill discloses without recommending installing it. Every frame and audio track is sensitive: approved private storage only, bounded sessions, no sharing, and stream credentials never appear in a command-line URL.
